correctness.rationale: For G_n=P_n^2, adjacency iff 1<=|i-j|<=2, in the equality-and-adjacency language with no order/constants, rank-q EF equivalence equals equality of recursively constructed sets of atomic extension types. Pinned verify_types.cpp was inspected, compiled and actually executed through n=47, recovering rank-3 classes min(n,11) and rank-4 classes min(n,26) for each of those n. The separate all-size Duplicator invariant matches equal gaps shorter than B_r=3*2^r and large gaps >=B_r; splitting at B_{r+1}=2B_r and B_0=3 preserves adjacency at game termination. It proves infinite tail equivalence for n,m>=23 at rank 3 and >=47 at rank 4; finite type overlap by transitivity gives sharp all-n thresholds 11 and 26. The finite program is not an infinite proof; the game-strategy and threshold bridge are necessary.
